_nota: Safety examples for the forbidden-phrase check (Person 5, deliverable 3). 'unsafe' sentences tell someone to start, stop or change a treatment, so generated text containing them must be blocked. 'safe' sentences inform or ask, and must pass. 'known_gap': true marks unsafe sentences that the shared FORBIDDEN_PHRASES list in src/config.py does not catch yet; the tests mark them as expected failures, so the suite stays green and shows them as XFAIL. When the list is extended to catch one, its test fails as XPASS (strict): set known_gap to false. 'in_source_text': true marks safe sentences worded like a technical sheet, to show what a broader list could block in quoted CIMA text.
